specific_diseases_listed: Hypertension/Diabetes/Cardiac Conditions (90 days unless pre-existing & disclosed)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Specific Illnesses & Procedures 2 years. Hypertension/Diabetes/Cardiac 90 days except if disclosed pre-existing. Major Illness-Benefit 90 days. COVID-19 15 days.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Pro Plan (3-5L): Single Pvt AC Room. Plus Plan (6-20L): Single Pvt AC Room. Premium Plan (25L+ up to 1 Cr): Actuals up to SI
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Covers Mental Healthcare, HIV/AIDS, Genetic Disorder (max Rs.1L), Internal Congenital (25% SI), Bariatric, Advance Procedures (25% SI), Cataract (Rs.50K-1L per eye).

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Covered up to Sum Insured - 537 Day Care Procedures

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (includes pre and post hospitalization cover)

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (Ayurvedic, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Major Illness Benefit (optional rider): up to 100% SI or max Rs.25 lakhs whichever lower; Survival 30 days; IWP 90 days

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Sum Insured Refill: 100% Basic SI on complete or partial utilization, once per policy year (including CB or Enhanced CB)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual from 1st renewal year (CBC, Haemoglobin, FBS, Lipid Profile, LFT, KFT, TSH, Urine etc.)
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Tier of tests varies by plan (Pro/Plus/Premium).

room_rent_capping: Pro 3-4L: Single Pvt AC Room (1% restriction option); Pro 5L: Single Pvt AC Room (Upgrade option). Plus: Single Pvt AC Room (Upgrade excluding suite & above). Premium: Actuals up to SI.
icu_capping: Pro 3-4L: Actuals (2% restriction option); Pro 5L/Plus/Premium: Actuals
copayment_trigger_notes: 10% or 20% optional Co-payment available (rider). Default no co-payment.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance) up to Rs.5 lakhs (Plus) / Rs.10 lakhs (Premium) within India for travel 150+ km from home.

permanent_exclusions: Surgical treatment of obesity not fulfilling necessary conditions
notable_exclusions_summary: Arogya Supreme excludes maternity and infertility, refractive error, unproven treatments, and treatment outside India. The policy notably covers 20 basic benefits including HIV/AIDS, Mental Healthcare, Genetic Disorders, and Internal Congenital Anomaly. 8 optional add-ons available including Major Illness Benefit (lump-sum up to Rs.25L).
claim_process_summary: Call 1800 210 3366 / 1800 210 6366 or email sbig.health@sbigeneral.in. SMS HEALTHCLAIM to 561612. Visit www.sbigeneral.in.
available_riders: Major Illness Benefit (up to Rs.25L lump sum)
Additional Sum Insured for Accidental Hospitalization (1.5x or 2x)
